phases.name: PH1
phases.description: CSA Phase 1 works including FSA, DCH, EYD, MYD and SSA structural steel, steel decking, secondary steel, metal stairs, ladders, railings, bollards and associated steel items across foundations, roofs, envelopes and external works.
zones: SSA Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing
activities: Primary structural steel frames FSA
Primary structural steel frames DCH
Steel decking to FSA and DCH roofs
Intumescent fire protection to primary steel (1h and 2h ratings)
Holding down bolt assemblies supply and casting coordination
Secondary steel for cladding support (FSA & DCH)
Miscellaneous steel: internal and external stairs, cat ladders, roof hop-overs
Miscellaneous steel: crash protection, bollards, railings, roof walkways, open mesh gratings
Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel (Shell A) with galvanizing
Gantry emergency stairs and associated railings and gratings
Structural steel supports for RMUs and battery boxes over trenches
Generator trench structural steel with corrosion protection and intumescent coating
Hold down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS, CTB, ASB, S24, S25, MUP and USS/Shell A structures
Steel columns kickers/bolts within slabs (EYD)
Secondary steel for wall cladding and canopies
Louvre framing and steelwork penetrations at envelope
Metal cat ladders to penthouse and roofs
Metal stairs over roof parapets (Phase 2 only flagged but generally steel scope)
Roof railings and roof access steelwork for SSA building
Cycle route, fencing and bollards (steel bollards and metal posts)
Safety fabrications to support assembled stairs at roof level
Steps and ramps including handrails for MCP/USS
Grouting of steel bases and base plates to concrete
Shotblast and hot-dip galvanizing to EN ISO 1461 for exposed steel items
Corrosion protection painting systems suitable for C2 environment category
Intumescent paint fire protection (60 minutes) for trench steels
Touch-up painting after erection prior to handover
dependencies: Concrete foundations, slabs, plinths and ground beams completed for each structure (by others)
Holding down bolt assemblies supplied by steel contractor and cast into concrete by CSA/civil contractor
Waterproofing and earthing mat works around foundations completed in advance of steel erection where applicable
Cladding installation dependent on completion of primary structural steel and secondary steel
Roof systems (Euroclad/Kingspan) dependent on steel decking and primary steel completion
Intumescent fire protection applied after shop primer/galvanizing and before final enclosure
External steel gantries and support steel dependent on completion of corresponding foundations (MCP, USS, CTG, MWT, ASB, CTB, S24, S25, etc.)
constraints: All structural steel fabricated to Execution Class 2, steel grade S355, erected per NSSSBC 5th Edition
Galvanizing to EN ISO 1461 for external and exposed steel elements including gantries, ladders, railings and certain SSA steel
Corrosion protection paint systems designed for C2 environment for specific trench steels
Intumescent paint fire ratings to be coordinated with fire strategy (2h for main FSA/DCH in PH1; 60min for specific trench steels)
Interfaces with concrete works for H.D.A. (holding down assemblies) and grout to be coordinated
Interfaces with envelope trades for secondary steel, louvre and canopy penetrations through cladding and roof
Roof access steel (cat ladders, hop-overs, railings, walkways) to comply with roof system requirements and waterproofing detailing
Access and lifting constraints for large gantry steel (Cooling Tower Gantry, Generator Trench, USS trench) to be considered in method statements

phases.name: PH2
phases.description: CSA Phase 2 works focused on DCH superstructure: structural steel frames, steel decking, secondary steel for envelope, steel stair and access elements, and MYD cooling-related gantry steels.
activities: Primary structural steel frames DCH (Phase 2 tonnage)
Roof steel decking to DCH
Holding down bolt assemblies for DCH PH2 steel
Intumescent fire protection 1h rating for DCH PH2 steelwork
Additional external steelwork/metalwork: cat ladders, bollards, stairs over roof parapets, small roof stairs
Secondary steelwork for DCH envelope cladding
Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel (Shell A) with galvanizing (PH2 portion)
Structural steel RMU & battery supports over trench (PH2 portion) with galvanizing
Gantry emergency stairs, cat ladders, railings and open mesh gratings for Cooling Tower Gantry PH2
Supply of holding down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS, S25 foundations (PH2)
Steps and ramps including handrails for MCP and USS (PH2)
Grouting of steel bases associated with PH2 DCH slabs and foundations
dependencies: Completion of DCH PH2 foundations and floor slabs (CSA CONCRETE WORKS, REINFORCEMENT and FORMWORK scopes)
Installation of PH2 earthing mat and waterproofing to foundations
Casting in of H.D.A. (free issue from structural steel subcontractor)
Completion of Cooling Tower Gantry PH2 foundations and pad/plinth works
Completion of MCP and USS foundations PH2
Envelope cladding and doors PH2 dependent on completion of structural and secondary steel
Roof Euroclad system PH2 dependent on completion of steel decking and primary steel
constraints: All DCH PH2 structural steel to Execution Class 2, S355, NSSSBC 5th Edition
Cooling Tower Gantry steel and RMU supports PH2 to be shotblasted and galvanized to EN ISO 1461
Intumescent paint 1h system for PH2 DCH frame steel (DFT and compatibility per project specs)
Secondary steel for cladding to be coordinated with cladding panel layout and penetrations
Access and lifting planning for gantry steel and roof steelworks for PH2
Hold down bolt assemblies schedule and casting coordination with concrete contractor for PH2 MCP, USS and S25

phases.name: PH3
phases.description: CSA Phase 3 works including DCH superstructure continuation, MYD/EYD external yards and CT Gantry steel, with structural steel and secondary steel packages mirroring Phase 2 scope at increased extent.
activities: Primary structural steel frames DCH (PH3 tonnage)
Steel decking to DCH roof (PH3 allocation)
Holding down bolt assemblies and H.D.A. casting for DCH PH3
Intumescent paint 1h to DCH PH3 structural steel
External stairs (ground to roof level) DCH
Bollards associated with PH3 DCH external works
Further secondary steel for DCH envelope cladding (PH3 allocation)
Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel (Shell A) with galvanizing (PH3 portion)
Gantry emergency stairs, cat ladders, bumper railings in front of chillers, walkways and grating (Cooling Tower Gantry PH3)
Structural steel RMU & battery supports over trench PH3 with galvanizing
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 PH3
Steps and ramps including handrails for MCP and USS PH3
Grouting of steel bases linked to DCH PH3 slabs and foundations
Steel columns kickers/bolts to EYD PH3 slabs for column interface
Radon-related dressing around columns and grouting steel bases in DCH PH3
dependencies: Completion of DCH PH3 foundations, slabs and earthing mat
Casting in of H.D.A. and chemical anchor H.D.A. into slabs as per drawings
Completion of Cooling Tower Gantry PH3 pad foundations, ground beams and plinths
Completion of MCP and USS foundations PH3, with waterproofing and bitumen coatings where applicable
Steel erection sequence for Gantry structures coordinated with MYD densified yard works
Roof envelope and Euroclad system PH3 dependent on steel decking and primary steel completion
Cladding works PH3 dependent on secondary steel availability and penetrations coordination
constraints: Execution Class 2, S355 and NSSSBC 5th Edition apply to all PH3 structural steel packages
Cooling Tower Gantry and trench steels PH3 to be shotblasted and galvanized to EN ISO 1461
Cat ladders, bumper railings, railings and walkways to be detailed to suit roof build-ups and waterproofing
Intumescent coatings for DCH PH3 to meet required fire rating while compatible with galvanized/primed substrates
Interfaces with radon/vapour membranes and bitumen DPMs at ground beam edges must be respected by steel detailing
Access constraints around operational or partially completed plant when erecting CT Gantry and MCP/USS steel in PH3

phases.name: PH4
phases.description: CSA Phase 4 works comprising final DCH structural steel and envelope expansions and MYD cooling gantry steels, closing out the multi-phase structural program.
activities: Primary structural steel frames DCH (PH4 tonnage)
Steel decking to DCH roof (PH4 allocation)
Holding down bolt assemblies for DCH PH4 structural steel
Intumescent paint 1h to DCH PH4 steel
Additional external steelwork/metalwork: cat ladders, bollards, small roof stairs (Phase 4 allocation)
Secondary steel for DCH envelope cladding (PH4 portion)
Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel Shell A (PH4 tonnage) with galvanizing
CT Gantry cat ladders, stairs, railings and open mesh grating (PH4 portion)
Structural steel RMU & battery supports across trenches (PH4) including galvanizing
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 foundations (PH4)
Steps and ramps including handrails for MCP and USS (PH4)
Grouting of steel bases in DCH PH4 slabs and foundations
dependencies: Completion of DCH PH4 foundations, slabs, earthing mat and formwork
Casting in of H.D.A. and associated DPM/bitumen/insulation around steel bases
Completion of Cooling Tower Gantry PH4 foundations and MCP/USS/S25 foundation phases
Roof Euroclad system PH4 dependent on steel decking and primary steel installation
Cladding and door/window installation PH4 dependent on secondary steelworks completion
Sequence coordination with earlier PH1–PH3 works to avoid clashes and provide access for final gantry and roof steel
constraints: All PH4 structural steel to Execution Class 2, S355, erected per NSSSBC 5th Edition
CT Gantry and trench steelwork PH4 to be shotblasted and galvanized to EN ISO 1461
Intumescent paint 1h for PH4 DCH structural steel with compatible primer systems
Secondary steel to be coordinated with Eurobond/Kingspan cladding and parapet cappings
Hold down bolt assembly supply and casting windows must align with concrete pour program for PH4 foundations
Working at height constraints for CT Gantry, roof parapet stairs and roof walkways in PH4 completed facility context

zones.name: FSA
zones.description: Facility Support Area including structural steel superstructure, steel decking, envelope and roof systems plus associated plant platforms and access steel.
activities: FSA Structural Steel frame (Execution Class 2, S355)
FSA Roof steel decking (TATA D60x1.2mm and composite top deck systems)
Holding down bolt assemblies for FSA steelwork (H.D.A.)
Intumescent paint 2h fire protection to FSA steel
Internal stairs FSA (steel)
External steelwork/metalwork at loading dock: fencing, handrails, crash protection, cat ladders, roof hop-over steps, bollards
Secondary steel for FSA envelope and canopies
Roof walkways and upstands, roof railings and roof access ladders
Additional FSA AHU foundations and associated hold down assemblies for AHU steel (by others but interface to SS)
FSA insulation at slab perimeter influencing steel base detail and grouting
zones.logistics: Primary FSA frame and deck to be erected prior to cladding and roof envelope. Access required for MEWP/crane for stair and external steel installation around loading dock and roof.

zones.name: DCH
zones.description: Data Centre Hall (core building) with multi-phase foundations, slabs, primary structural steel, steel decking and cladding/roof envelope.
activities: DCH Structural Steel frames in PH1–PH4 (Execution Class 2, S355)
DCH Roof steel decking in PH1–PH4
DCH Intumescent paint systems (2h in PH1, 1h in PH2–PH4 as scheduled)
Holding down bolt assemblies DCH PH1–PH4 and associated grouting
External stairs ground-to-roof (steel) PH1/PH3 and additional roof parapet stairs PH2/PH4
Bollards around DCH perimeter in multiple phases
Secondary steel for DCH envelope in PH1–PH4
Eurobond Rockspan wall panels and Kingspan roof liner relying on secondary steel
Roof Euroclad top deck with walkways and temporary protection in PH1–PH4
Roof cat ladders, railings, roof access stairs and hop-overs
Multiple foundation phases PH1–PH4 providing pads and encasements for steel stanchions and base plates
zones.logistics: Four structural phases with repeating pattern: foundations and slabs, erection of primary steel, installation of decking, fire protection, envelope closure. Coordination of hold down bolt casting and earthing with steel program is critical.

zones.name: EYD
zones.description: External Yard (EYD) with large foundation slabs receiving steel columns and associated kickers/kickers bolts.
activities: Steel column kickers/bolts within EYD slabs (interfaces for main frames or gantries)
Backfilling around slab edges after structural works
USS plinths within EYD linking to USS steel frames
zones.logistics: EYD slabs must be cast with embedded steel kickers/bolts and hold down assemblies to receive superstructure frames. Access for cranes required before backfilling.

zones.name: MYD
zones.description: Main/Yard Densified area (water cooled) with large structural slabs, utility trenches and cooling tower gantries and associated pad foundations.
activities: MYD Concrete Slab/Yard (by others) receiving structural steel trestles, cooling equipment and gantries
Generator Trench Structural Steel (C2 paint, 60min intumescent, touch-up, H.D. bolts)
USS Trench Structural Steel with C2 paint, 60min intumescent and H.D. bolts
Structural Steel support for RMUs and battery boxes over trench (Shell A) PH1–PH4
Cooling Tower Gantry Structural Steel Shell A PH1–PH4 with galvanizing, H.D.A., touch-up
Gantry emergency stairs, cooling tower stairs, cat ladders, railings, bumper railings and open mesh grating
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS, CTB, ASB, S24, S25 and other MYD-related foundations
zones.logistics: Sequenced erection of trench steels and cooling gantry after respective foundations and MYD densified slabs are complete. Gantry works require heavy lifting, careful coordination with cooling plant installation and water-cooled system interfaces.

zones.name: MCP
zones.description: Modular Cooling Plant foundations and associated access/steelwork.
activities: MCP foundations (by others) with H.D.A. for structural steel gantries/supports
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies for MCP (PH1–PH4 as listed)
Steps and ramps including handrails at MCP for access (PH2–PH4)
Cooling Tower Gantry steel adjacent to MCP foundations in MYD
zones.logistics: MCP foundations and hold down bolts must be coordinated with delivery and erection of modular cooling plant and associated gantry steel; steps/ramps installed after main steel in place.

zones.name: USS
zones.description: Universal Sub-Station foundations, plinths and associated structural steel and access works.
activities: USS 150mm plinths with steel column kickers/bolts
USS foundations (by others) with H.D.A. for steelwork
Cooling Tower Gantry and trench steel linking to USS
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies for USS (PH1–PH4)
Steps and ramps incl. handrails for USS (PH2–PH4)
zones.logistics: USS plinths and foundations must be completed with embedded steel fixings before erection of substation enclosures and any superstructure steel.

zones.name: Cooling Tower Gantry (CT Gantry / CTB / MWT / ASB / S24 / S25 / USS Trestles)
zones.description: Family of gantry and trestle structures supporting cooling towers and associated plant, with extensive galvanized structural steelwork and multiple pad and trestle foundations.
activities: Cooling Tower Gantry Structural Steel (Shell A) with galvanized finish
Gantry Emergency Stairs and Cooling Tower Stairs
Cat ladders to gantry levels
Railings and bumper railings around cooling equipment
30mm open mesh grating for access platforms
Pad foundations, ground beams and plinths for Gantry (CTB, MWT, ASB, USS, S24, S25, various PHs)
Supply of hold down bolt assemblies for S24 and S25 (PH1–PH4)
Surface touch-up painting after erection
zones.logistics: Works distributed over MYD; heavy lifts and sequence around MWT, CTB, ASB and USS trestle foundations; coordination with cooling tower installation and pipework routes.

zones.name: SSA - Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing
zones.description: Ancillary building (Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing) with its own structural steel frame, roof and envelope integrated into the CSA scope.
activities: (Shell A) Structural Steel frame including H.D.A.
Galvanizing and surface touch-up to EN ISO 1461 for external exposed elements
Roof deck single spanning (Kingspan RD100/825) with associated roof railings and cat ladder
Euroclad Rockspan cladding, parapet capping, scuppers, downpipes and rolling shutter
Foundations and plinths with H.D.A. casting and CRC coating to slabs
Cycle route (asphalt) adjacent to building influencing access and protection of steel
Additional FSA AHU foundations interfacing structurally with SSA steel roof or platforms
Smoke extract louvres (SSA-specific) in FSA facades across phases PH1–PH4
zones.logistics: SSA building likely located near FSA/yard with independent erection sequence but tied into overall access and fire strategy via louvres, AOVs and roof access steel.

zones.name: Generator Trench (EYD/MYD)
zones.description: Dedicated structural steel within a generator trench system, including corrosion protection and fire protection for steel supports to generators and services.
activities: Generator Trench Structural Steel (0.79 t listed for PH1) with corrosion protection paint (C2), 60min intumescent, touch-up after erection and holding down bolts (supply only)
USS Trench Structural Steel system (10.43 t) with same C2 and 60min intumescent coating system
Structural steel support for RMUs and battery boxes sitting across the trench (PH1)
Interface with CT Gantry and MYD densified slab
zones.logistics: Trench steels must be installed after trench concrete works and before backfill; coatings largely factory-applied, with on-site touch-up prior to handover.

zones.name: Site Development (Roads/Paths/Pavings/Fencing)
zones.description: External siteworks under CSA that include elements with steel content or critical steel interfaces.
activities: Fencing and Bollards with steel posts and steel bollards (PH1 & PH3)
Security fencing (chainlink on metal posts) around RSA
Timber fence and gates around attenuation pond (limited steel but with interfaces to site foundations)
Cycle route (asphalt) and surface paviors that may interface with steel bollards and trench covers
Concrete load bank storage slab and fuel oil offloading areas (interfaces for modular steel units installed by others)

Concrete foundations not in design for mini pillars, pipe bases and plinths supporting superstructure steel (trestles, modular buildings, walkways/platforms, generators) including grout in base plates from superstructures installed by others
2-step external door platforms formed in concrete supporting access stairs (interfaces with external steel stair units)
Waste management area foundations including H.D.A. and generator flue support
zones.logistics: External routes and yards must be coordinated with cranage routes for steel erection, and embedded steel (bollards, base plates, RSA angles) cast-in during pavement construction.

zones.name: RSA (Security Fence & Attenuation Pond)
zones.description: Perimeter security fence and attenuation pond works, with steel content limited to fences and gates.
activities: 3m high chainlink fence on metal posts (no razor wire)
1.2m high timber post and rail fence around attenuation pond with gates
zones.logistics: Fences define site boundary and may constrain access and cranage for steel deliveries and erection. Steel content is in fence posts and gates.

primary_structural_steel_scopes: Main building frames for FSA and DCH in all phases
Steel decking to FSA and DCH roofs in all phases
Cooling Tower Gantry and associated gantry/trestle structures in MYD across phases
Generator and USS trench steels with corrosion and fire protection
SSA (Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing) structural steel, roof deck and envelope steelwork
Secondary steel for cladding and canopies on FSA and DCH
Miscellaneous steel: stairs, ladders, railings, bollards, bumper rails and gratings across zones
key_interfaces_and_risks: Extensive interface between structural steel base plates and concrete foundations/slabs (H.D.A. and grouting coordinates)
Multi-phase program for DCH requiring careful segregation of PH1–PH4 tonnage and fire rating requirements
Cooling Tower Gantry and trench steels involve heavy lifts, complex galvanizing and coating requirements and multiple foundation zones (CTB, MWT, ASB, USS, S24, S25, MCP, MUP, USS, etc.)
Secondary steel and envelope penetrations (louvres, canopies, smoke vents, roofing penetrations) carry coordination risk with steel detailing
Trench steel fire protection (60min intumescent) is distinct from main frame fire strategies
summary.concrete_items_handling: All concrete quantities, mix descriptions and pure concrete scope items have been ignored except where they define a direct interface with steel (e.g., holding down assemblies, grout in place, column encasements, concrete stub columns around steel stanchions). No concrete-related items are listed as activities unless they directly influence steel base conditions or erection risk.
summary.source_notes: BOQ processed top-to-bottom. Only records impacting structural steel scope, interfaces, protection or contractual risk were used to structure phases and zones. Phase labels rely on the 'PH1/PH2/PH3/PH4' fields; zone names are taken from descriptive headers (FSA, DCH, MYD, EYD, SSA, RSA, MCP, USS, etc.).
